module: Editor extension that adds the "ImGui Demo" menu entry (Debug group of the Window menu). It opens the built-in Dear ImGui demo window (ui_imgui.ShowDemoWindow), useful to a modder to see all the available ImGui widgets. It writes no data.
notes: The open state is a local BoolPtr (windowOpen); the demo window sets the value to false when the user closes it.
onWindowMenuItem is local (not exported): it cannot be called from another module.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame by the editor; if the window is open, displays the ImGui demo window.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called at editor initialization; registers the "ImGui Demo" menu in the Debug group via editor.addWindowMenuItem.
